analysis.narrativeEn:

· Swing Resistance ($156.49) + Potential for short-term bounce upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Failed Higher Low recovery, now turning down) + Potential for bearish trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (2.19x 5-day average) + Increased confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Downward correction within accumulation phase) + Conditions for entry/wait: Confirmation of RSI reclaiming above 50 and MACD improvement.
